nameOrigin: casually modify or repair, especially a mechanical object

pokedexEntries.sc: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

pokedexEntries.vi: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.

pokedexEntries.za: Tinkatuff sometimes come to human settlements, where they rummage through factories and warehouses to gather metal.
